status: read-only design; no product edit, build, GPU execution or new profiling
decision: Use the existing CUDA SSM_CONV carrier with an exact BF16 sample load and truthful time/channel/batch strides. Preserve its F32 weight loads, rolling window/shared memory, MAC sequence, bias addition and F32 output. This can eliminate the private sample Cast and its layout CONT without changing public CausalConv1d or Graph core.

evidence.fact: Retained decode7 has 18 sample BF16->F32 conversions after BF16 Concat, followed by F32 transpose and SSM convolution. The separate 18 F32->BF16 convolution-result conversions precede BF16 SiLU and are real rounding boundaries. This is earlier retained trace evidence, not a claim about the concurrently running GDN profile.

Independent earlier phase binning reports 18 transpose-copy F32 kernels, 18 causal-conv kernels and 18 standalone BF16 SiLU kernels per warm decode. Its old overall kernel count and performance are not the current baseline.

BF16 history plus BF16 QKV are concatenated as samples; next_history is a published Copy of its last K-1 positions. Samples and constant weights are explicitly cast to F32 for convolution. The result explicitly rounds to BF16 before ordinary BF16 SiLU.

Public CausalConv1d is dense [B,W,C] plus matching-type [C,K], F32 accumulation, output [B,W-K+1,C] of the declared input type. Current CUDA lowering admits F32 only and materializes permute(samples,1,0,2,3) via CONT before SSM_CONV.

Existing SSM_CONV constructor takes native samples [W,C,B] and weights [K,C], derives T=W-K+1 and creates F32 [C,T,B]. It does not require a new public operation or output type. The current CUDA patch manifest has no ssm-conv.cu edits.

actual_layout.before: Public F32 Cast output [B,W,C] is native [C,W,B,1]. Permute makes [W,C,B,1] with non-unit time stride; current CONT changes it to time-contiguous storage: nb0=4, nb1=W*4.
actual_layout.after: Take the exact original BF16 tensor of a private Cast, then use the same metadata permutation to [W,C,B,1]. For ordinary dense source its byte strides are nb0=C*2, nb1=2, nb2=W*C*2. Padded source rows/batches must retain their actual byte strides, never borrow the former F32 Cast layout.
actual_layout.not_removed: The BF16 Concat and published next_history Copy remain real graph values. This proposal does not make convolution own or mutate history, pack weights again, absorb SiLU, or remove the output BF16 RNE.

native_math.short: Lines6-55: x and w are float arrays; line45 initial window and line48 sliding update currently use unit time indices. Generalize only these loads to exact widen(sample[channel*channel_stride + time*time_stride]); keep the circular-window indices and the original line53 j-order sumf += x*w.
native_math.long: Lines59-124: load source samples into existing float shared memory at line93 with actual sample strides, then keep line119 j-order F32 MAC. Do not change split_n_t=32, block/channel distribution or the float shared representation merely to add a low-type input.
native_math.compile: Instantiate the BF16 input branch in the existing ssm-conv.cu fast-math compilation domain, with explicit exact BF16->float conversion at the original load. Keep legacy F32 launch/arithmetic behavior unchanged. The existing MAC contraction/FTZ policy must stay identical; do not move this computation into the strict SiLU TU or introduce half/BF16 products, tensor cores or a different accumulation tree.
native_math.boundary: Keep F32 convolution output including the original sumf += bias/zero behavior. Then retain the existing explicit F32->BF16 Cast, strict ordinary BF16 SiLU and its output RNE. The old native conv(+bias)+F32-SiLU formula is not equivalent to this public chain.

smallest_changes.change: In the existing CausalConv1d branch, reuse TensorBuildFrame::private_bfloat_widen_source from the GDN batch. Require an actual BF16 source with the same native extents as the original F32 Cast input to Conv and the supported original row layout. On a qualified private unique-reader unpublished Cast, pass a metadata permutation of that BF16 source directly to the ordinary SSM_CONV constructor. On miss, retain the current F32 permute+CONT exactly.
smallest_changes.lifetime: The source may have other BF16 readers, including published history Copy; that is not a reason to invent a new buffer or omit a real edge. Only the F32 Cast output must be private/single-reader. Do not fold a separately published/extra-read Cast output.

smallest_changes.files: Existing upstream src/ggml-cuda/ssm-conv.cu and ssm-conv.cuh, represented by precise CUDA patch-manifest edits
smallest_changes.change: Add a shared metadata-only typed qualification helper and a BF16 input instantiation of the existing short/long kernels/launch helper. Keep weights, optional bias and destination F32. Convert sample loads by type and true time/channel/batch byte strides; preserve all original F32 compute statements.
smallest_changes.safety: The long-kernel last tile must avoid loads for col >= local_n_t+K-1; zero-fill only those unused shared columns. The original loop currently prefetches K-1+32 columns without this guard. With interleaved stride C, old time-contiguous padding assumptions cannot justify those reads. This guard does not alter any valid convolution MAC input.

smallest_changes.change: Use the same typed metadata qualifier in supports_op and actual SSM_CONV dispatch. Actual encode additionally validates original CUDA buffer/device/capacity, alignment and disjoint source/weight/bias/output ranges. Keep legacy F32 branch and marked-SiLU exclusion unchanged; report a real bridge failure for an invalid bound typed operation rather than silently reading through F32 pointers.
smallest_changes.limit: No native allocation-only synthetic read dependency is needed for a single Conv whose src0 is the actual BF16 metadata view: the original graph has the real read edge and view ancestry. Do not keep an obsolete Cast/CONT edge as a substitute for actual source lifetime.

smallest_changes.files: Only if actual selection externalizes the Cast: src/graph_provider_ggml_cuda/ggml_cuda_region.cc
smallest_changes.change: The Frame optimization cannot see through an already external F32 region port. Verify the selected recipe first. If necessary, offer the minimal provider-private closed Cast(BF16->F32)->CausalConv1d pair using existing reader/output/control and allowed-node facts, leaving cold constant weight expressions as external prepared inputs. Do not enlarge an entire model island or reconstruct an external BF16 source from addresses.
smallest_changes.proof: A selected region is not a physical hit. A post-change trace must distinguish removed sample-copy/transpose kernels from preserved output narrowing and SiLU.

qualification: Keep actual native K template domain {3,4,5,9,15}, positive B/T/C, channels divisible by 128, and real device block/grid/shared-memory limits. Do not substitute C6144, K4, B1 or a model name for these implementation conditions.

Initially accept source rows contiguous in original channel order (channel byte stride2), with truthful positive nonoverlapping time/batch pitches. The metadata permutation gives the kernel its real [time,channel,batch] strides. Broader broadcast, overlapping, negative or arbitrary permuted sources remain on the original path unless explicitly implemented.

Check every byte stride fits the actual kernel parameter type, every pointer-offset product/sum is representable, and every logical/actual accessed range fits its original CUDA buffer. Use widened offset arithmetic or reject products that overflow the existing int expressions. Cold supports must not require data pointers; actual owner/capacity/RESTRICT checks remain at encode.

Output is dense F32 and must be disjoint from all read ranges. BF16 source cannot be treated as exact F32 inplace storage. Both bound views and view_src roots retain original resources/owners. Never add OUTPUT flags, shadow buffers or retained permissions just to force eligibility.

Keep weights as the existing F32 prepared constant or ordinary F32 input. Current evidence counts no per-token weight widen; do not claim a second weight-copy saving or expand the schema to mixed public operands.

Keep the existing marked stable-SiLU guard in main (current v23 source lines3632-3650,3778-3819). Do not let older SSM_CONV(+ADD)+UNARY fusion bypass the BF16 convolution result rounding or stable negative tail.
meaningful_small_tests: Extend the existing natural-sequence CUDA fixture (GgmlCudaTensor.MatureCausalConvUsesNaturalSequenceLayout) with a Graph BF16 source -> explicit F32 Cast -> CausalConv1d using F32 weights; compare with independently staged Direct F32 Cast/Conv and a small independent dot oracle. Use nonzero varied channel/tap values so a swapped time/channel stride cannot accidentally pass.

One small table covers T1 short, T33 partial long tile and T128 long path; B2 and C128/256 rather than only the model shape, with K3/4 covering history lengths. Include a true BF16 row/batch-padded source before the public dense Cast, plus exact BF16 values, signed zero/subnormal and NaN/Inf classifications. Do not relax finite bits to compensate for a changed MAC tree.

Retain an output BF16 Cast -> ordinary BF16 stable SiLU in at least one graph, and preserve/publish a slice-copy of BF16 samples as next_history. A separately published F32 Cast and an extra F32 reader are escape controls that must keep their actual values. Check old input/history backing remains unchanged.

Reuse existing two-slot/two-round fresh-address and capture harness. Actual correctness includes F32 Conv, BF16 result/SiLU and history outputs, not just a route ID. Existing F32 natural-layout and official Qwen3.8 exact-width conv tests remain useful neighboring controls; no full model/provider matrix is required for the first batch.

refresh_and_evidence.native: Fresh main ggml-cuda.cu and ssm-conv.cu from a coherent exact patch replay; ssm-conv.cuh declaration change has no new by-value struct. Reuse all other CUDA/SDK objects.
refresh_and_evidence.host: Fresh tensor_program.cc and provider version owner; one test TU. Refresh ggml_cuda_region.cc only if the actual cold selection needs the small pair proposal. No public header/Graph core ABI refresh is proposed.
refresh_and_evidence.expected_effect: At most the source-qualified 18 sample widen +18 transpose materializations per warm token disappear when every private pattern is present and selected. Conv18, output narrow18, BF16 SiLU18, Concat/history and constant packing remain. These 36 launches are a conditional structural target, not measured time or guaranteed workspace reduction.
refresh_and_evidence.required_after_implementation: Directed numerical/escape/stride/capture tests, exact full-model hidden/logit comparison plus IDs/history, one actual trace of typed conv and both removed families, actual workspace accounting, then paired unprofiled timing. Launch-count reduction alone is not a speed claim.

do_not_do: No public mixed CausalConv1d schema, model name/shape rules or Graph core changes.
No fused BF16 conv output/SiLU epilogue in this input-load batch; keep both rounding boundaries in their current operators.
No removal of Concat/history/state copy, cold weight reuse or source liveness merely because two pointers happen to match.
No change to prefill/decode math, K template set, F32 MAC order, FTZ/FMA policy, extra permissive layout capability or old F32 native behavior without separate evidence.
